verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no public HTTP or REST API for driving HumanLayer, and probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs at standard paths all returned 404. The documented CLI (`humanlayer automation run`) and the Jira, Slack, GitHub and Linear integrations are adjacent interfaces, not a documented public API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
